classes.name: Statins
classes.description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors: atorvastatin (Lipitor), rosuvastatin (Crestor, Ezallor), simvastatin (Zocor), pravastatin, lovastatin (Altoprev), pitavastatin (Livalo, Zypitamag), fluvastatin, and statin combinations (Vytorin, Roszet).
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill that lowers LDL cholesterol.

classes.name: Ezetimibe & other non-statin oral agents
classes.description: Non-statin oral LDL-lowering agents: ezetimibe (Zetia), bempedoic acid (Nexletol) and bempedoic acid/ezetimibe (Nexlizet).
classes.plainDescription: A cholesterol pill used with or instead of a statin.

classes.name: PCSK9 inhibitors & siRNA
classes.description: Injectable PCSK9-pathway agents: evolocumab (Repatha), alirocumab (Praluent), inclisiran (Leqvio).
classes.plainDescription: An injection every 2 weeks to 6 months that strongly lowers LDL cholesterol.

records.verificationNote: Read PDL p.58 (lipotropics, statins; statin PA criteria listed above the table: treatment failure with at least two preferred drugs for 120+ days combined, contraindication, allergic reaction, stage-four cancer, duplicate therapy, or no preferred option in class). Preferred statins with no PA: atorvastatin, LIPITOR, lovastatin, pravastatin, rosuvastatin, simvastatin. Preferred pick is generic atorvastatin (judgment call on cost and volume; PDL states no tiers). All statin combinations (CADUET, VYTORIN, and generics) are non-preferred. Roszet is not on the PDL and is not inferred excluded. [Sonnet check 2026-10-21: PDL p.58 states the 'Duplicate Therapy' clinical PA applies to all drugs in the statin class; added to preferredRestriction.]

Clinical PA 'Hyperlipidemia agents' applies to all PCSK9 inhibitors. Confirm with the plan.

records.verificationNote: Read PDL pp.57-58. REPATHA and PRALUENT are both in the preferred column for PCSK9 inhibitors (p.58). The PA criteria block for this section (p.57-58) lists criteria: trial of atorvastatin, rosuvastatin and ezetimibe; concurrent atorvastatin or rosuvastatin therapy; contraindication or allergy to preferred drugs; stage-four cancer; or no preferred option in class. A clinical PA ('Hyperlipidemia agents') is listed for all PCSK9 inhibitors. Read literally, preferred status does not waive these. Judgment call: both agents are in the preferred column, so the PA block is recorded as a restriction, not as paRequired. INCLISIRAN (Leqvio) does not appear on the PDL; it is not inferred excluded. [Sonnet check 2026-10-21: re-read pp.57-58 / p.81: clinical PA stated as applying to all PCSK9 inhibitors / all drugs in the non-stimulant table; preferredRestriction confirmed.]
